recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore old MedicationPrescription-specific prose unless Pharmacy reopens SIG guidance or changes the R6 DosageDetails/renderedInstruction model.
issue_request: FHIR-5271 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy issue asking to clarify MedicationPrescription dosage instruction text so free text can be used when instructions are too complex to code and can still be present for human display when coded instructions are present.
initial_application: Historical git commit d406f9a2c0 updated Pharmacy resources based on ballot resolutions and added the accepted sentence to the then-current MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.text spreadsheet row. Later source history renamed MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest and moved dosageInstruction details into reusable Dosage and R6 DosageDetails surfaces.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationRequest, Dosage, and DosageDetails in active build scope and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Later Pharmacy decisions already represented on the combined branch refined the same family: FHIR-39319 clarified Dosage.text as complete SIG text, FHIR-54014 required DosageDetails.renderedInstruction to communicate full dosage intent, and FHIR-12150 added separate patientInstruction wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build already provides human-readable dosage instructions through required DosageDetails.renderedInstruction on MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction and complete Dosage.text SIG wording for individual Dosage entries.
